newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's J.Martins suspended on Lisbon bourse.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's J.Martins suspended on Lisbon bourse.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese retailer Jeronimo Martins were suspended on Lisbon bourse, a bourse spokesman said.

He told Reuters the reason for the suspension was that the company had released no statement after Diario de Noticias newspaper reported that it had bought Portuguese drinks group Vidago on Wednesday for 15.5 billion escudos.
The provisional notification of the public offer to buy (OPA) is due to be delivered to the Financial Markets Committee (CMVM) on Thursday, the paper said.
A Jeronimo Martins spokesman, contacted by Reuters, declined comment on the deal but said the company would issue a statement to the CMVM by 1300 GMT on Thursday.
